name: Mark
source:
Mark is a local surfer known for his confidence, charm, and easygoing attitude.

Beneath his relaxed exterior lies a loyal and caring person who values honesty and meaningful connections. His unexpected meeting with Alex becomes the beginning of a relationship that may change both of their lives.
